review_scope: Different-author static and synthetic-only review of the exact M1619 source, test, contract and author receipt, bound to the exact M1610/M1615/M1539/docs359 identities. No actual payload was opened and no L2/L3 execution occurred.

verified_strengths.canonical_prefix: D0/call0/timestep0 destinations 0..41, 42 destinations and 168 commits per configuration
verified_strengths.geometry: four destination parities plus corner, edge and interior
verified_strengths.pairwise_exact_miter: all 20 per-request and all 16 per-destination exact fields reject one-sided mutations
verified_strengths.structural_guards: skip, reset, incomplete prefix, missing/out-of-range RSS and selected backwards counters reject
verified_strengths.source_only_boundary: actual_prefix_release rejects even with a supplied provider/token; no actual CLI or payload token; all paper claims remain false

evidence: last_request_return stores the latest request return rather than the maximum, so an earlier return at cycle 5000 is accepted with destination last_cycle below 5000
an outstanding return at cycle 5000 may disappear at the next destination before that cycle
last_psum_write_ready may move backwards from 5000 to zero
cache valid_entries/state may reset from nine entries to zero while only tick/hit/miss/eviction counters remain monotonic
p1.required_repair: Retain the maximum issued return, previous active-return projection, previous last-psum vector and cache-content identity; validate legal retirement/dependency/cache transitions from accepted requests rather than monotonic counters alone.

evidence: equal reference/compact requests with module=99, timestep=99, destination=41 and output_block=99 are accepted while validating destination zero
four accepted commit requests can be summarized as four external_read requests with zero bytes
arbitrary changing 64-hex address and commit digests are accepted without derivation from accepted request records
p1.required_repair: Bind every request to frozen module/timestep/current destination/output-block bounds and incrementally derive kind counts, bytes and packed digests inside the miter from the accepted request stream.

evidence: validate_bundle accepts three hand-written finish rows with zero requests, no dense coverage and no completed CanonicalPrefixMiter sessions as long as configuration/order/destination/commit/digest fields match
p1.required_repair: Make finish rows unforgeable by the runner interface or validate a sealed per-session identity containing source/resource/population, nonzero request totals and required coverage; require three distinct fresh sessions and forbid scheduler/cache reuse across configurations.

p2: RSS is correctly required and bounded per destination but intentionally is not a pairwise exact field; the repaired source should state this comparison policy explicitly.

single_next_authorization.authorized: Author a separately named source-only successor that repairs the three M1620 P1 interface gaps and adds deterministic synthetic mutations for every survivor.
not_authorized: authoring an actual L2 runner against the current M1619 interface
opening, hashing or executing the actual ep34 payload
cycle, traffic, speedup, energy, PPA, Table-A or paper claims
single_next_authorization.next_gate: The exact repaired source/test/contract must receive a new different-author review with P0=0 and P1=0 before an actual L2 one-shot runner source may be authored. Execution remains a later gate.
